verdict.rationale: PagerDuty ships an official MCP server that lets AI assistants such as Claude Desktop, Cursor and VS Code fetch and manage account data, so users can operate PagerDuty through natural-language prompts. It also lists an Anthropic Claude connector. Natively, PagerDuty Advance adds agentic and generative AI, and its Insights Agent offers on-demand conversational insights. Missing for 10: documented native natural-language command coverage for operational actions (the conversational features evidenced are analytics-focused), an inventory of which MCP tools/actions are supported, and independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works in practice.
